items.description: Clothing and jewellery stolen from the car
items.rationale: Buildings-only policy: theft/removal by third parties is not an insured peril (2.1, 3.1.4); personal effects (4.3(d)) and property in a conveyance away from the insured location (4.3(e),(f), 4.5) are not insured. Not indemnified.
No insured event; conveyance-related and journey costs are expressly excluded (5.2.5, 7.1.8(d), 2.3.7). Not indemnified.
